types.name: auth.v1.AccountIdentity
types.doc: AccountIdentity is a lightweight identity view for a root account.

fields.name: account_id
fields.doc: Root account identifier (opaque ID).

fields.name: username
fields.doc:
Current username for the root account (unique, case-insensitive). Empty
 means no username set.

fields.name: avatar_url
fields.doc: Avatar URL, if set. Maximum length is 256 characters.

fields.name: root_smart_account_address
fields.doc: Root smart-account EVM address. Useful as a stable identity fallback.

fields.name: scope_type
fields.doc: Address-book scope type.

fields.name: root_account_id
fields.doc: Root account that owns this address book.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc: Subaccount for subaccount-scoped books. Empty for root account books.

types.name: auth.v1.AccountScopeType
types.doc: AccountScopeType identifies whether address-book data belongs to the root account or a subaccount.

values.name: SCOPE_ROOT
values.doc: Root account scope.

values.name: SCOPE_SUBACCOUNT
values.doc: Subaccount scope.

types.name: auth.v1.ActivityEvent
types.doc: Activity or audit event for a sub-account.

fields.name: created_at
fields.doc: Time when the event occurred.

fields.name: entity_kind
fields.doc: Type of entity changed, such as "subaccount", "api_key", or "invite".

fields.name: event_action
fields.doc: Action that occurred, such as "created", "updated", or "removed".

fields.name: source
fields.doc: Source of the event, such as "web", "mobile", or "api".

fields.name: ip
fields.doc: Origin IP address. Masked for non-owner and non-admin callers.

fields.name: user_agent
fields.doc: User agent associated with the event, when available.

fields.name: actor_account_id
fields.doc: Account that performed the action (opaque ID).

fields.name: payload_json
fields.doc: Structured event details as a JSON string. Maximum 64 KiB.

fields.name: scope
fields.doc: Account or subaccount represented by this address book.

fields.name: caller_role
fields.doc: Caller role for this address book.

fields.name: label
fields.doc: Display label for the address book. Usually present for subaccounts.

fields.name: owner_username
fields.doc: Username of the root owner when available.

fields.name: smart_account_address
fields.doc: Smart account address associated with this account or subaccount.

fields.name: external
fields.doc: Saved external withdrawal destinations.

fields.name: internal
fields.doc: Saved internal transfer destinations.

fields.name: address_book_entry_id
fields.doc: Stable public id of the saved address-book entry.

fields.name: scope
fields.doc: Address book that owns this entry.

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: Type of saved destination.

fields.name: label
fields.doc: User-defined display label.

fields.name: note
fields.doc: Optional user-defined note.

fields.name: created_at
fields.doc: Time this entry was created, as a UTC timestamp.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.doc: Time this entry was last updated, as a UTC timestamp.

fields.name: external
fields.doc: External chain withdraw destination.

fields.name: internal
fields.doc: Internal account transfer destination.

fields.name: tags
fields.doc: Tags currently attached to this entry.

types.doc: AddressBookEntryKind identifies the type of saved transfer destination.

values.name: EXTERNAL_CHAIN
values.doc: External network withdrawal address.

values.name: INTERNAL_ACCOUNT
values.doc: Internal exchange account.

fields.name: external
fields.doc: Recent external withdrawal destinations that are not saved in the address book.

fields.name: internal
fields.doc: Recent internal transfer destinations that are not saved in the address book.

fields.name: tag_id
fields.doc: Stable public id of the tag.

fields.name: scope
fields.doc: Address book scope where this tag exists.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Human-readable tag name.

fields.name: color
fields.doc: Optional UI color token for this tag.

fields.name: created_at
fields.doc: Time the tag was created, as a UTC timestamp.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.doc: Time this tag was last updated, as a UTC timestamp.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Human-readable tag name.

fields.name: color
fields.doc: Optional UI color token for this tag.

fields.doc: Stable public id of the tag.

fields.name: name

fields.name: color
fields.doc: Optional UI color token for this tag.

types.name: auth.v1.AddressBookViewInvalidated
types.doc: AddressBookViewInvalidated notifies clients to refetch the address-book aggregate view.

fields.name: scope
fields.doc: Address-book scope whose aggregate view may have changed.

fields.name: invalidated_at
fields.doc: Time the view was invalidated.

types.name: auth.v1.ApiKey
types.doc: ApiKey is public API key metadata. It never includes the private key or seed.

fields.name: key_id
fields.doc:
Stable opaque identifier used to refer to this key, formatted as "ak_"
 followed by 32 lowercase hex characters.

fields.name: label
fields.doc: Human-readable label for the key. Maximum length is 64 characters.

fields.name: icon
fields.doc: Optional user-chosen icon/emoji for UI display.

fields.name: color
fields.doc: Optional user-chosen color token for UI display.

fields.name: ip_whitelist
fields.doc:
Optional CIDR whitelist. Empty means no IP restriction. Maximum 32 unique
 entries.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: Current key status.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc: Optional sub-account this key is scoped to (opaque ID; empty = root-level).

fields.name: policy_id
fields.doc:
Optional API policy attached to this key (opaque ID).
 Empty means "no per-key policy", so only the sub-account policy (and roles) apply.

fields.name: created_at
fields.doc: Time in UTC when this key was created.

fields.name: last_used_at
fields.doc:
Last time in UTC when this key authenticated a request. Omitted when the
 key has not been used.

fields.name: public_key_ed25519
fields.doc:
Ed25519 public key bytes associated with this API key. The private key or
 seed is never returned by the API.

fields.name: expires_at
fields.doc:
Optional expiry time in UTC. When set, the key cannot authenticate requests
 after this time, regardless of status.

fields.name: created_by_actor
fields.doc:
Read-only actor label describing who created this key, such as a username
 or account label.

types.name: auth.v1.ApiKeyStatus
types.doc: Status of an API key.

values.name: ACTIVE
values.doc: Key can authenticate requests.

values.name: REVOKED
values.doc: Key has been permanently revoked and cannot be used again.

values.name: DISABLED
values.doc: Key is temporarily disabled and cannot authenticate requests until re-enabled.

types.name: auth.v1.ApiPolicyView
types.doc:
ApiPolicyView is the public view of an API key policy template. API key
 policy limits are additional caps and cannot exceed the sub-account policy.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Policy identifier (opaque ID).

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Human-readable policy name.

fields.name: description
fields.doc: Optional policy description for dashboards and audits.

fields.name: spot_markets
fields.doc: Allowed spot markets for this API key policy.

fields.name: perp_markets
fields.doc: Allowed perp contracts for this API key policy, with optional per-contract caps.

fields.name: actions
fields.doc:
High-level actions enabled for this API key. Up to 64 unique explicit
 actions may be returned.

fields.name: spot_market_scope
fields.doc:
Market-level scope for spot markets. When ALL, spot_markets is returned
 for display only and is not enforced.

fields.name: perp_market_scope
fields.doc:
Market-level scope for perp contracts. When ALL, perp_markets is returned
 for display only and is not enforced.

fields.name: max_order_notional
fields.doc:
Maximum notional size allowed for any single order via this key, expressed
 in a canonical quote unit (e.g. micro-USDT). A value of 0 means "no
 explicit additional cap" beyond the sub-account policy.

fields.name: daily_internal_transfer_out_limit
fields.doc:
Maximum total notional this API key can transfer out internally per day,
 expressed in the canonical quote unit (for example, micro-USDT). A value of
 0 means no additional cap beyond the sub-account policy.

fields.name: daily_withdraw_limit
fields.doc:
Maximum total notional this API key can withdraw per day, expressed in the
 canonical quote unit (for example, micro-USDT). A value of 0 means no
 additional cap beyond the sub-account policy.

fields.name: is_template
fields.doc:
When true, this policy is intended to be reused as a template across
 multiple API keys. When false, it represents a single-key instance.

fields.name: source_template_id
fields.doc:
Optional source template this policy was copied from (opaque ID). This is
 audit metadata only and does not imply live linkage.

fields.name: created_at
fields.doc: Creation time in UTC.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.doc: Last update time in UTC.

types.name: auth.v1.AuthErrorCode
types.doc: High-level error codes for authentication and account-domain failures.

values.name: AUTH_USERNAME_INVALID
values.doc: Username format or characters are invalid.

values.name: AUTH_USERNAME_TAKEN
values.doc: Username is already used by another account.

values.name: AUTH_USERNAME_COOLDOWN
values.doc: Username was changed too recently.

values.name: AUTH_USERNAME_FEATURE_LOCKED
values.doc: Account is not currently eligible to claim or change a username.

values.name: AUTH_USERNAME_RESERVED
values.doc: Username is reserved and cannot be claimed by this account.

values.name: AUTH_INVALID_REQUEST
values.doc: Request is malformed or missing required input.

values.name: AUTH_AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED
values.doc: Authentication is required for this operation.

values.name: AUTH_SESSION_KIND_NOT_ALLOWED
values.doc: Presented session type is not allowed for this operation.

values.name: AUTH_WALLET_LOGIN_FAILED
values.doc: Wallet login failed because the nonce or signature could not be verified.

values.name: AUTH_RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND
values.doc: Requested resource was not found.

values.name: AUTH_SUBACCOUNT_ACCESS_DENIED
values.doc: Caller does not have access to the requested sub-account.

values.name: AUTH_API_KEY_ACCESS_DENIED
values.doc: Caller does not have access to the requested API key.

values.name: AUTH_API_KEY_MFA_REQUIRED
values.doc: API key operation requires MFA.

values.name: AUTH_API_KEY_INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION
values.doc: Requested API key status transition is not allowed.

values.name: AUTH_POLICY_INVALID
values.doc: Policy definition or binding is invalid.

values.name: AUTH_SMART_ACCOUNT_ALREADY_LINKED
values.doc: Smart-account address is already linked to another account.

values.name: AUTH_INVITE_ACCESS_DENIED
values.doc: Caller does not have access to the requested invite.

values.name: AUTH_INVITE_INVALID_STATE
values.doc: Invite cannot be used in its current state.

values.name: AUTH_MFA_DISABLED
values.doc: MFA is not available for this account.

values.name: AUTH_MFA_NOT_ENROLLED
values.doc: Required MFA factor is not enrolled.

values.name: AUTH_MFA_SESSION_INVALID
values.doc: MFA session is missing, expired, or invalid.

values.name: AUTH_MFA_CHALLENGE_NOT_FOUND
values.doc: MFA challenge was not found.

values.name: AUTH_MFA_CHALLENGE_INVALID
values.doc: MFA challenge payload is invalid.

values.name: AUTH_MFA_CHALLENGE_LOCKED
values.doc: MFA challenge is locked after too many failed attempts.

values.name: AUTH_MFA_OTP_INVALID
values.doc: One-time password is invalid.

values.name: AUTH_MFA_RECOVERY_INVALID
values.doc: Recovery code is invalid.

values.name: AUTH_MFA_PASSKEY_NOT_AVAILABLE
values.doc: Passkey verification is not available for this challenge.

values.name: AUTH_MFA_PASSKEY_CREDENTIAL_INVALID
values.doc: Passkey credential is invalid for this account or challenge.

values.name: AUTH_MFA_PASSKEY_VERIFY_FAILED
values.doc: Passkey verification failed.

values.name: AUTH_MFA_ENROLLMENT_BINDING_INVALID
values.doc: MFA enrollment binding is invalid or expired.

values.name: AUTH_STEP_UP_REQUIRED
values.doc: A fresh step-up proof is required for this protected operation.

values.name: AUTH_STEP_UP_PROOF_UNAVAILABLE
values.doc: A requested step-up proof is unavailable.

values.name: AUTH_STEP_UP_ALREADY_CLAIMED
values.doc: The step-up proof has already been claimed.

types.name: auth.v1.AuthErrorDetail
types.doc: AuthErrorDetail describes an authentication or account-domain failure.

fields.name: code
fields.doc: Stable machine-readable auth error code.

fields.name: message
fields.doc: Human-readable error message.

types.name: auth.v1.BeginMFAChallengeRequest
types.doc: Request to start an MFA challenge.

fields.name: purpose
fields.doc: Desired challenge outcome: session elevation or fresh step-up.

types.name: auth.v1.BeginMFAChallengeResponse
types.doc: Response returned after starting an MFA challenge.

fields.name: challenge_id
fields.doc: Challenge identifier to submit when verifying a factor. Format: "mfa_" followed by 32 lowercase hex characters.

fields.name: allowed_factor_types
fields.doc: Factor types the caller may use for this challenge. Maximum 8 unique values.

fields.name: public_key
fields.doc: Passkey request options when passkey verification is available. Empty when passkeys are not available.

fields.name: expires_at
fields.doc: Time when this challenge expires.

types.name: auth.v1.BeginPasskeyEnrollmentRequest
types.doc: Request to begin passkey enrollment.

fields.name: label
fields.doc: Optional human-friendly label for the passkey. Maximum 128 characters.

types.name: auth.v1.BeginPasskeyEnrollmentResponse
types.doc: Response containing passkey enrollment options.

fields.name: enrollment_id
fields.doc: Enrollment challenge identifier. Format: "mfa_" followed by 32 lowercase hex characters.

fields.name: public_key
fields.doc: Passkey creation options to pass to the browser or device authenticator.

fields.name: expires_at
fields.doc: Time when this enrollment challenge expires.

types.name: auth.v1.BeginTOTPEnrollmentRequest
types.doc: Request to begin authenticator-app enrollment.

fields.name: label
fields.doc: Optional human-friendly label. Defaults to "Authenticator App" when empty. Maximum 128 characters.

types.name: auth.v1.BeginTOTPEnrollmentResponse
types.doc: Response containing the authenticator-app enrollment secret.

fields.name: enrollment_id
fields.doc: Enrollment challenge identifier. Format: "mfa_" followed by 32 lowercase hex characters.

fields.name: secret
fields.doc: Shared secret to enter into an authenticator app. Returned only when enrollment begins.

fields.name: otpauth_uri
fields.doc: Authenticator-app setup URI for QR-code display. Returned only when enrollment begins.

fields.name: expires_at
fields.doc: Time when this enrollment challenge expires.

types.name: auth.v1.ClaimFreshStepUpRequest
types.doc: Request to bind a fresh step-up proof to one protected request.

fields.name: request_id
fields.doc: Client-generated request identifier for the protected request. Maximum 128 characters.

fields.name: action_type
fields.doc: Product action being protected, such as a withdrawal or security setting change. Maximum 64 characters.

fields.name: subject
fields.doc: Product subject for the protected action, such as the target account, destination, or resource identifier. Maximum 128 characters.

types.name: auth.v1.ClaimFreshStepUpResponse
types.doc: Response returned after a fresh step-up proof is claimed.

fields.name: step_up_id
fields.doc: Fresh step-up proof identifier. Format: "mfa_" followed by 32 lowercase hex characters.

fields.name: claim_nonce
fields.doc: One-time nonce that must be echoed when consuming or releasing the claim.

fields.name: claim_expires_at
fields.doc: Time when this claim expires if it is not consumed or released.

types.name: auth.v1.CompleteMFAChallengeResponse
types.doc: Response returned after an MFA challenge is completed.

fields.name: session
fields.doc: Session assurance details after completing the challenge.

fields.name: access_token
fields.doc: MFA-elevated session token returned for session-elevation challenges. Empty for fresh step-up challenges.

fields.name: access_token_expires_at
fields.doc: Time when access_token expires. Empty when no access_token is returned.

fields.name: step_up_token
fields.doc: Fresh step-up token returned for fresh step-up challenges. Empty for session-elevation challenges.

fields.name: step_up_expires_at
fields.doc: Time when step_up_token expires. Empty when no step_up_token is returned.

types.name: auth.v1.ConsumeFreshStepUpRequest
types.doc: Request to consume a claimed fresh step-up proof after the protected request succeeds.

fields.name: step_up_id
fields.doc: Fresh step-up proof identifier returned by ClaimFreshStepUp.

fields.name: request_id
fields.doc: Client-generated request identifier used when the proof was claimed.

fields.name: action_type
fields.doc: Product action type used when the proof was claimed.

fields.name: subject
fields.doc: Product subject used when the proof was claimed.

fields.name: claim_nonce
fields.doc: One-time nonce returned by ClaimFreshStepUp.

types.name: auth.v1.ConsumeFreshStepUpResponse
types.doc: Empty response returned after a fresh step-up proof is consumed.

fields.name: tag_ids

types.name: auth.v1.CreateApiKeyRequest
types.doc:
CreateApiKeyRequest creates a new API key. Clients generate the Ed25519 key
 pair locally and submit only the public key.

fields.name: label
fields.doc: Human-readable label for the key. Required; 1 to 64 characters.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc:
Optional sub-account to scope this key to (opaque ID). If unset, the key is
 root-level.

fields.name: icon
fields.doc: Optional user-chosen icon/emoji for UI display.

fields.name: color
fields.doc: Optional user-chosen color token for UI display.

fields.name: ip_whitelist
fields.doc:
Optional CIDR whitelist. Empty means no IP restriction. Maximum 32 unique
 entries.

fields.name: public_key_ed25519
fields.doc:
Ed25519 public key bytes. Must be exactly 32 bytes. The private key or seed
 must never be sent to the API.

types.name: auth.v1.CreateApiKeyResponse
types.doc: CreateApiKeyResponse returns the created API key metadata.

fields.name: api_key
fields.doc: Created API key metadata. The private key or seed is never returned.

types.name: auth.v1.CreateApiPolicyRequest
types.doc: CreateApiPolicyRequest defines a new API key policy template.

cel.message: spot_markets must be non-empty when spot_market_scope is ALLOWLIST
perp_markets must be non-empty when perp_market_scope is ALLOWLIST
spot_markets must not contain duplicate symbols
perp_markets must not contain duplicate symbols

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Human-readable policy name. Required; 1 to 64 characters.

fields.name: description
fields.doc: Optional policy description for dashboards and audits. Maximum 256 characters.

fields.name: spot_markets
fields.doc: Allowed spot markets for this API key policy.

fields.name: perp_markets
fields.doc: Allowed perp markets and optional per-contract leverage caps.

fields.name: spot_market_scope
fields.doc: Market-level scope for spot markets. When unspecified, defaults to ALL.

fields.name: perp_market_scope
fields.doc: Market-level scope for perp contracts. When unspecified, defaults to ALL.

fields.name: actions
fields.doc:
High-level actions enabled for the API key policy. Up to 64 unique explicit
 actions are allowed.

fields.name: max_order_notional
fields.doc:
Maximum notional size for any single order submitted with this API key,
 expressed in the canonical quote unit (for example, micro-USDT). A value of
 0 means no additional cap beyond the sub-account policy.

fields.name: daily_internal_transfer_out_limit
fields.doc:
Maximum total notional this API key can transfer out internally per rolling
 day, expressed in the canonical quote unit (for example, micro-USDT). A
 value of 0 means no additional cap beyond the sub-account policy.

fields.name: daily_withdraw_limit
fields.doc:
Maximum total notional this API key can withdraw per rolling day, expressed
 in the canonical quote unit (for example, micro-USDT). A value of 0 means
 no additional cap beyond the sub-account policy.

fields.name: is_template
fields.doc: Whether this policy should be treated as a reusable template.

fields.name: assign_to_key_id
fields.doc:
Optional API key identifier to bind this newly-created policy to
 atomically. When set, the caller must be allowed to manage the key and the
 create+assign operation consumes a single fresh step-up proof.

types.name: auth.v1.CreateApiPolicyResponse
types.doc: CreateApiPolicyResponse returns the created API key policy.

fields.name: policy
fields.doc: Created API key policy.

types.name: auth.v1.CreateSubaccountPolicyRequest
types.doc:
CreateSubaccountPolicyRequest defines a new sub-account policy template, with
 an optional attach step for one target sub-account.

cel.message: spot_markets must be non-empty when spot_market_scope is ALLOWLIST
perp_markets must be non-empty when perp_market_scope is ALLOWLIST
spot_markets must not contain duplicate symbols
perp_markets must not contain duplicate symbols

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Human-readable policy name. Required; 1 to 64 characters.

fields.name: description
fields.doc: Optional policy description for dashboards and audits. Maximum 256 characters.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc:
Optional: if set, the created policy will be immediately attached to this
 sub-account (opaque ID) in the same request. Useful for "create
 policy for this sub-account" flows. Omit to create reusable templates.

fields.name: spot_markets
fields.doc: Allowed spot markets for this policy.

fields.name: perp_markets
fields.doc: Allowed perp markets and optional per-contract leverage caps.

fields.name: spot_market_scope
fields.doc: Market-level scope for spot markets. When unspecified, defaults to ALL.

fields.name: perp_market_scope
fields.doc: Market-level scope for perp contracts. When unspecified, defaults to ALL.

fields.name: actions
fields.doc:
High-level actions enabled for the sub-account policy. Up to 64 unique
 explicit actions are allowed.

fields.name: global_notional_cap
fields.doc:
Maximum total notional exposure across all positions for this sub-account,
 expressed in the canonical quote unit (for example, micro-USDT). A value of
 0 means no explicit cap.

fields.name: max_order_notional
fields.doc:
Maximum notional size for any single order on this sub-account, expressed
 in the canonical quote unit (for example, micro-USDT). A value of 0 means
 no explicit cap.

fields.name: max_open_orders
fields.doc:
Maximum number of resting orders allowed on this sub-account at any time.
 A value of 0 means no explicit cap.

fields.name: max_open_positions
fields.doc:
Maximum number of open perp positions allowed on this sub-account. A value
 of 0 means no explicit cap.

fields.name: global_perp_leverage_x
fields.doc:
Optional global leverage cap across all perp contracts. Supported non-zero
 values are 1, 3, 5, 10, 20, 50, and 100. A value of 0 means no explicit cap.

fields.name: daily_internal_transfer_out_limit
fields.doc:
Maximum total notional this sub-account can transfer out internally per
 rolling day, expressed in the canonical quote unit (for example,
 micro-USDT). A value of 0 means no explicit cap.

fields.name: daily_withdraw_limit
fields.doc:
Maximum total notional this sub-account can withdraw per rolling day,
 expressed in the canonical quote unit (for example, micro-USDT). A value of
 0 means no explicit cap.

fields.name: internal_transfers_own_only
fields.doc:
When true, internal transfers from this sub-account may only target other
 sub-accounts owned by the same root account.

fields.name: enforce_withdraw_whitelist
fields.doc:
When true, external withdrawals from this sub-account must target an
 approved withdrawal destination.

fields.name: trading_halted
fields.doc:
When true, new orders for this sub-account are rejected regardless of other
 policy settings.

fields.name: liquidation_only
fields.doc: When true, this sub-account may only reduce or close existing exposure.

fields.name: daily_loss_limit
fields.doc:
Maximum realized loss over a rolling day before safety controls may halt
 activity, expressed in the canonical quote unit (for example, micro-USDT).
 A value of 0 means no explicit limit.

fields.name: intraday_drawdown_limit_bps
fields.doc:
Maximum drawdown from peak equity in basis points. One basis point is
 1/100 of one percent. A value of 0 means no explicit limit.

fields.name: locked
fields.doc: When true, the policy is write-protected and requires an elevated mutation path.

fields.name: review_at
fields.doc: Optional review time in UTC. This does not automatically disable the policy.

fields.name: expires_at
fields.doc: Optional expiry time in UTC. This does not automatically disable the policy.

types.name: auth.v1.CreateSubaccountPolicyResponse
types.doc: CreateSubaccountPolicyResponse returns the created sub-account policy.

fields.name: policy
fields.doc: Created sub-account policy.

types.name: auth.v1.CreateSubaccountRequest
types.doc: Request to create a new sub-account under the caller's root account.

fields.name: label
fields.doc: Optional human label for display in UI.

cel.message: label must not contain '<' or '>'

fields.name: icon
fields.doc: Optional user-chosen icon/emoji for UI display.

fields.name: color
fields.doc: Optional user-chosen color token for UI display. Tokens use lowercase letters, numbers, underscores, or hyphens.

fields.name: smart_account_address
fields.doc: Smart Account EVM address for the new sub-account.

fields.name: nonce
fields.doc:
Auth challenge nonce returned by GetNonce for this smart account. This is
 not the smart-account derivation salt nonce.

fields.name: signature
fields.doc: Signature over the canonical login message containing the nonce.

fields.name: primary_wallet_address
fields.doc: Optional primary wallet address supplied by the client. Sub-account ownership is proven by the Smart Account signature.

fields.name: wallet_provider
fields.doc: Optional provider hint supplied by the client. Sub-account creation does not depend on this value.

types.name: auth.v1.CreateSubaccountResponse
types.doc: Response returned after creating a sub-account.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc: Identifier for the created sub-account (opaque ID).

fields.name: total_created
fields.doc:
Total number of sub-accounts that have ever been created for this root,
 including soft-deleted ones. Returned here so clients can immediately
 derive the next salt/index without requiring a fresh ListSubaccounts call.

fields.name: smart_account_salt_nonce
fields.doc:
Smart-account derivation salt nonce assigned to the created sub-account.
 Today this equals total_created for a successful create.

types.name: auth.v1.ResolveAccountRequest
types.doc:
ResolveAccountRequest searches for a transfer or sharing destination by
 username, account ID, or smart-account address.

fields.name: query
fields.doc:
Free-form query typed by the user. Can be:
 - a username, 3 to 64 characters using letters, digits, underscore, dot, or hyphen
 - an opaque root account or sub-account ID
 - an EVM smart-account address formatted as 0x plus 40 hex characters
 Maximum length is 128 characters.

fields.name: hint
fields.doc:
Optional hint for how to parse query. When unspecified, the service
 auto-detects by query shape.

fields.name: include_subaccounts
fields.doc:
When true, allow matches on sub-accounts as well as root accounts. Use
 this for internal transfer flows where the caller may want to resolve a
 specific sub-account by its ID or smart-account address. Username
 lookups remain root-only regardless of this flag.

types.name: auth.v1.ResolveAccountResponse
types.doc:
ResolveAccountResponse contains matching accounts. Username and root-only
 smart-account lookups return at most 5 matches; smart-account lookups with
 include_subaccounts may return at most 10 matches.

fields.name: matches
fields.doc: Matching destination accounts. Empty means no account matched the query.

types.name: auth.v1.ResolveHint
types.doc: ResolveHint controls how ResolveAccount interprets the query.

values.name: USERNAME
values.doc: Treat query as a username. Username lookups resolve root accounts only.

values.name: ID
values.doc: Treat query as an opaque root account or sub-account ID.

values.name: SMART_ACCOUNT
values.doc: Treat query as an EVM smart-account address.

types.name: auth.v1.ResolvedAccount
types.doc:
ResolvedAccount represents a lightweight view of a destination account for
 sharing or internal transfers.

fields.name: smart_account_address
fields.doc:
Smart-account address that would receive funds. This is the address that
 will receive the transfer, whether it belongs to a root account or a
 sub-account.

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: Kind of account that owns this address: "root" or "sub".

fields.name: root_username
fields.doc:
Root account username for the result. For sub-account results, this is the
 parent root account username. Empty means the root account has no username.

fields.name: subaccount_label
fields.doc: Optional sub-account label when kind == "sub".

fields.name: account_id
fields.doc:
Target account identifier (opaque ID). For root results this is an account
 ID; for sub-account results this is a sub-account ID.

fields.name: action

fields.name: invite
fields.doc: Invitation after applying the response action.

fields.name: session_level
fields.doc: Assurance level represented by this session response.

fields.name: authentication_methods
fields.doc: Authentication methods used for this session state, such as wallet, TOTP, passkey, or recovery code. Maximum 8 unique values.

fields.name: auth_time

values.name: FRESH_STEP_UP
values.doc: A short-lived proof for one high-risk action.

types.name: auth.v1.SetApiKeyPolicyRequest
types.doc: SetApiKeyPolicyRequest attaches or clears a policy template on an API key.

fields.doc:
Opaque API key identifier, formatted as "ak_" followed by 32 lowercase hex
 characters.

Policy template to attach (opaque ID). A value of 0 clears the policy

When true, delegated interactive members must satisfy MFA requirements for

 subscriptions.

types.doc: Empty response returned after updating the delegated-member MFA requirement.

SetSubaccountPolicyRequest attaches or clears a policy template on a
 sub-account.

fields.name: subaccount_id

fields.doc:
Policy template to attach (opaque ID). A value of 0 clears the policy

types.name: auth.v1.SocialProvider
types.doc: Social account provider used for account ownership verification.

values.doc: X/Twitter account verification.

values.name: DISCORD
values.doc: Discord account verification.

types.name: auth.v1.SocialVerification
types.doc:
SocialVerification describes the caller's current verification state for one
 social provider.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Verification identifier.

fields.name: provider
fields.doc: Provider account being verified.

fields.name: method
fields.doc:
Method used for this verification. If unspecified at start time, profile
 verification is used.

fields.name: handle
fields.doc:
Provider handle being verified. Handles are returned lowercase and without
 a leading "@".

fields.name: provider_user_id
fields.doc: Stable provider-side user identifier. Empty until verification succeeds.

fields.name: challenge_code
fields.doc:
Challenge code the user must place according to the verification method.
 Codes start with "poly_" and expire after 15 minutes.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: Current verification status.

fields.name: requested_at
fields.doc: Time in UTC when the current challenge code was issued.

fields.name: expires_at
fields.doc: Time in UTC when the current challenge code expires.

fields.name: verified_at
fields.doc: Time in UTC when verification succeeded. Empty until status is STATUS_VERIFIED.

fields.name: attempts
fields.doc: Number of recorded provider-check attempts for this challenge.

fields.name: last_error
fields.doc:
Last verification error, if the most recent check failed. Empty when there
 is no recorded error.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.doc: Time in UTC when this verification state last changed.

types.name: auth.v1.SocialVerificationMethod
types.doc: How the user proves control of the provider account.

values.name: METHOD_PROFILE
values.doc: User places the challenge code in their public provider profile.

values.name: METHOD_CHANNEL
values.doc: User posts the challenge code in a provider channel.

values.name: METHOD_DM
values.doc: User sends the challenge code in a direct message.

types.name: auth.v1.SocialVerificationReadyRequest
types.doc:
SocialVerificationReadyRequest tells the API that the challenge code has been
 placed and the provider account is ready to check.

fields.name: provider
fields.doc: Provider account to check.

types.name: auth.v1.SocialVerificationReadyResponse
types.doc:
SocialVerificationReadyResponse returns the verification after it has been
 queued for a provider check.

fields.name: verification
fields.doc: Current verification state after the provider check was requested.

types.name: auth.v1.SocialVerificationStatus
types.doc: Current state of a social account verification attempt.

values.name: STATUS_PENDING_USER_ACTION
values.doc: Code issued; waiting for the user to complete the provider-specific action.

values.name: STATUS_QUEUED
values.doc: User marked the code as placed and the verification check is waiting to run.

values.name: STATUS_IN_PROGRESS
values.doc: Verification check is currently running.

values.name: STATUS_VERIFIED
values.doc: Provider account ownership was verified successfully.

values.name: STATUS_FAILED
values.doc: Verification failed. Start a new verification to receive a new challenge code.

values.name: STATUS_EXPIRED
values.doc: Challenge code expired before verification completed.

values.name: STATUS_CANCELLED
values.doc: Verification was cancelled.

types.name: auth.v1.SpotMarketRule
types.doc: SpotMarketRule describes an allowed spot market for a sub-account policy.

fields.name: symbol
fields.doc: Spot market symbol, e.g. "BTC-USDT".

types.name: auth.v1.StartSocialVerificationRequest

StartSocialVerificationRequest starts or restarts social account verification.
 Starting again for the same provider replaces the previous challenge.

types.name: auth.v1.Subaccount
types.doc: Sub-account summary visible to the caller.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Sub-account identifier (opaque ID).

fields.name: role
fields.doc: Role of the current caller on this sub-account.

fields.name: label
fields.doc: Optional human-readable label for this sub-account.

fields.name: icon
fields.doc: Optional user-chosen icon/emoji for UI display.

fields.name: color
fields.doc: Optional user-chosen color token for UI display. Tokens use lowercase letters, numbers, underscores, or hyphens.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: Current status of the sub-account, such as "active" or "disabled".

fields.name: smart_account_address
fields.doc: Smart Account EVM address backing this sub-account.

fields.name: owner_username
fields.doc: Owner (root account) public username, if set. Useful for shared views.

fields.name: owner_avatar_url
fields.doc: Owner (root account) avatar URL, if set.

fields.name: owner_root_smart_account_address
fields.doc:
Owner (root account) primary Smart Account address, when available. Allows
 clients to display a stable identity even when no username is set.

fields.name: subaccount_policy_id
fields.doc:
Optional sub-account policy identifier (opaque ID). 0 means no
 explicit policy attached.

fields.name: require_member_mfa
fields.doc:
Owner-controlled security baseline for delegated interactive members on
 protected sub-account actions. This does not apply to read-only real-time
 subscriptions.

fields.name: smart_account_salt_nonce
fields.doc:
Smart-account derivation salt nonce assigned when this sub-account was
 created. Present only when the caller owns the sub-account and can use it
 for direct chain signing.

types.name: auth.v1.SubaccountInvite
types.doc: View of a pending or historical invitation to a sub-account.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Invite identifier (opaque ID).

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc: Target sub-account (opaque ID).

fields.name: grantee_account_id
fields.doc: Grantee root account ID the invite is for (opaque ID).

fields.name: inviter_account_id
fields.doc: Inviter root account ID (opaque ID).

fields.name: role
fields.doc: Requested role for the grantee.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: Current invitation status.

fields.name: created_at
fields.doc: Time when the invitation was created.

fields.name: responded_at
fields.doc: Time when the invitation was accepted, declined, or cancelled. Empty while pending.

fields.name: grantee_username
fields.doc: Optional usernames for better UX in invite lists.

fields.name: subaccount_label
fields.doc: Optional label for the target sub-account, for display in invite lists.

fields.name: inviter_root_smart_account_address
fields.doc:
Inviter (root account) primary Smart Account address, when available.
 Useful for displaying a stable identity when no username is set.

fields.name: grantee_root_smart_account_address
fields.doc:
Grantee (root account) primary Smart Account address, when available.
 Useful for displaying a stable identity when no username is set.

fields.name: require_member_mfa
fields.doc: Current delegated-member MFA requirement on the target sub-account. If true, accepting the invite requires MFA enrollment and fresh step-up.

types.doc: Action to take on a sub-account invitation.

values.doc: Accept an incoming invitation as the grantee.

values.name: SUBACCOUNT_INVITE_ACTION_CANCEL
values.doc: Cancel an outgoing invitation as the inviter.

types.name: auth.v1.SubaccountInviteStatus
types.doc: Status of an invitation to join a sub-account.

values.name: SUBACCOUNT_INVITE_STATUS_PENDING
values.doc: Invitation is waiting for the grantee to respond.

values.doc: Invitation was accepted and access was granted.

values.name: SUBACCOUNT_INVITE_STATUS_DECLINED
values.doc: Invitation was declined by the grantee.

values.name: SUBACCOUNT_INVITE_STATUS_CANCELLED
values.doc: Invitation was cancelled by the inviter.

types.name: auth.v1.SubaccountMemberView
types.doc: Member summary for a root account with access to a sub-account.

fields.name: account_id
fields.doc: Identifier for the member's root account (opaque ID).

fields.name: role
fields.doc: Effective role on this sub-account.

fields.name: username
fields.doc: Optional username for the member's root account.

fields.name: smart_account_address
fields.doc: Smart Account address for the member's root account, if any.

fields.name: avatar_url
fields.doc: Optional avatar URL for the member's root account.

fields.name: mfa_enrolled
fields.doc: True when the member has at least one MFA factor enrolled on their root account.

types.name: auth.v1.SubaccountPolicyView
types.doc: SubaccountPolicyView is the public view of a sub-account policy.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Policy identifier (opaque ID).

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Human-readable policy name.

fields.name: description
fields.doc: Optional policy description for dashboards and audits.

fields.name: spot_markets
fields.doc: Allowed spot markets for this sub-account.

fields.name: perp_markets
fields.doc: Allowed perp contracts for this sub-account, with optional per-contract caps.

fields.name: spot_market_scope
fields.doc:
Market-level scope for spot markets. When ALL, spot_markets is returned
 for display only and is not enforced.

fields.name: perp_market_scope
fields.doc:
Market-level scope for perp contracts. When ALL, perp_markets is returned
 for display only and is not enforced.

fields.name: actions
fields.doc:
High-level actions enabled for the sub-account. Up to 64 unique explicit
 actions may be returned.

fields.name: is_template
fields.doc:
True if this policy is a reusable template; false if it is a
 per-sub-account instance.

fields.name: source_template_id
fields.doc:
Optional source template this policy was copied from (opaque ID). This is
 audit metadata only and does not imply live linkage.

fields.name: global_notional_cap
fields.doc:
Maximum total notional exposure (across all positions) allowed for this
 sub-account, expressed in a canonical quote unit (e.g. micro-USDT).
 A value of 0 means "no explicit cap".

fields.name: max_order_notional
fields.doc:
Maximum notional size allowed for any single order on this sub-account,
 expressed in the same canonical quote unit as global_notional_cap.
 A value of 0 means "no explicit cap".

fields.name: max_open_orders
fields.doc:
Maximum number of resting orders allowed on this sub-account at any time.
 A value of 0 means "no explicit cap".

fields.name: max_open_positions
fields.doc:
Maximum number of open perp positions allowed on this sub-account.
 A value of 0 means "no explicit cap".

fields.name: global_perp_leverage_x
fields.doc:
Optional global leverage cap across all perp contracts, expressed as a
 maximum leverage multiple. Supported non-zero values are 1, 3, 5, 10, 20,
 50, and 100. A value of 0 means "no explicit global cap"; per-contract
 caps still apply.

fields.name: daily_internal_transfer_out_limit
fields.doc:
Maximum total notional this sub-account can transfer out internally per
 day, expressed in the canonical quote unit (for example, micro-USDT). A
 value of 0 means "no explicit cap".

fields.name: daily_withdraw_limit
fields.doc:
Maximum total notional this sub-account can withdraw per day, expressed in
 the canonical quote unit (for example, micro-USDT). A value of 0 means "no
 explicit cap".

fields.name: internal_transfers_own_only
fields.doc:
When true, internal transfers from this sub-account may only target other
 sub-accounts owned by the same root account. When false, transfers to
 other owners are allowed (subject to other policy checks).

fields.name: enforce_withdraw_whitelist
fields.doc:
When true, external withdrawals from this sub-account must target an
 approved withdrawal destination.

fields.name: trading_halted
fields.doc:
When true, trading on this sub-account is halted: new orders are rejected
 regardless of other settings. Existing positions may still be closed by
 product safety controls.

fields.name: liquidation_only
fields.doc:
When true, this sub-account is in liquidation-only mode: new exposure
 cannot be opened, but reduce-only / close-out actions are allowed.

fields.name: daily_loss_limit
fields.doc:
Maximum allowed realized loss for this sub-account over a rolling day
 before safety controls may halt activity, expressed in the canonical quote
 unit (for example, micro-USDT). A value of 0 means "no explicit limit".

fields.name: intraday_drawdown_limit_bps
fields.doc:
Maximum allowed drawdown from peak equity in basis points (1/100 of a
 percent) before safety controls may halt activity. A value of 0 means "no
 explicit limit".

fields.name: locked
fields.doc:
When true, this policy is write-protected and requires an elevated approval
 flow to modify it.

fields.name: review_at
fields.doc:
Optional review time in UTC. This is governance metadata and does not
 automatically disable the policy.

fields.name: expires_at
fields.doc:
Optional expiry time in UTC. This is governance metadata and does not
 automatically disable the policy.

fields.name: created_at
fields.doc: Creation time in UTC.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.doc: Last update time in UTC.

types.name: auth.v1.UpdateApiKeyRequest
types.doc: UpdateApiKeyRequest updates mutable metadata for an existing API key.

cel.message: expires_at must be in the future or zero
cel.expression: !has(this.expires_at) ? true : this.expires_at == timestamp('1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') ? true : this.expires_at > now

fields.name: key_id
fields.doc: Opaque API key identifier to update.

fields.name: label
fields.doc:
New human-friendly label for the key. If empty, label is left unchanged.
 Maximum length is 64 characters.

fields.name: icon
fields.doc: New user-chosen icon/emoji for UI display. If empty, left unchanged.

fields.name: color
fields.doc: New user-chosen color token for UI display. If empty, left unchanged.

fields.name: status
fields.doc:
Optional new status. ACTIVE and DISABLED are allowed; REVOKED must be done
 via DeleteApiKey and is terminal.

fields.name: ip_whitelist
fields.doc:
Optional new IP whitelist. If this field is omitted, the whitelist is left
 unchanged. If it is present:
 - cidrs non-empty replaces the existing whitelist.
 - cidrs empty clears the whitelist (no IP restriction).

fields.name: expires_at
fields.doc:
Optional new expiry time in UTC. If this field is present:
 - Non-zero timestamp sets/updates the expiry.
 - Zero/epoch timestamp clears the expiry (no automatic expiry).
 If this field is omitted, the expiry is left unchanged.

fields.name: policy_id
fields.doc: Policy identifier (opaque ID).

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Human-readable policy name. Required; 1 to 64 characters.

fields.name: description
fields.doc: Optional policy description for dashboards and audits. Maximum 256 characters.

fields.name: spot_markets
fields.doc: Allowed spot markets for this API key policy.

fields.name: perp_markets
fields.doc: Allowed perp markets and optional per-contract leverage caps.

fields.name: spot_market_scope
fields.doc: Market-level scope for spot markets. When unspecified, defaults to ALL.

fields.name: perp_market_scope
fields.doc: Market-level scope for perp contracts. When unspecified, defaults to ALL.

fields.name: actions
fields.doc:
High-level actions enabled for the API key policy. Up to 64 unique explicit
 actions are allowed.

fields.name: max_order_notional
fields.doc:
Maximum notional size for any single order submitted with this API key,
 expressed in the canonical quote unit (for example, micro-USDT). A value of
 0 means no additional cap beyond the sub-account policy.

fields.name: daily_internal_transfer_out_limit
fields.doc:
Maximum total notional this API key can transfer out internally per rolling
 day, expressed in the canonical quote unit (for example, micro-USDT). A
 value of 0 means no additional cap beyond the sub-account policy.

fields.name: daily_withdraw_limit
fields.doc:
Maximum total notional this API key can withdraw per rolling day, expressed
 in the canonical quote unit (for example, micro-USDT). A value of 0 means
 no additional cap beyond the sub-account policy.

fields.name: is_template
fields.doc: Whether this policy should be treated as a reusable template.

types.name: auth.v1.UpdateSubaccountPolicyRequest
types.doc:
UpdateSubaccountPolicyRequest fully replaces an existing sub-account policy
 template.

cel.message: spot_markets must be non-empty when spot_market_scope is ALLOWLIST
perp_markets must be non-empty when perp_market_scope is ALLOWLIST
spot_markets must not contain duplicate symbols
perp_markets must not contain duplicate symbols

fields.name: policy_id
fields.doc: Policy identifier (opaque ID).

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Human-readable policy name. Required; 1 to 64 characters.

fields.name: description
fields.doc: Optional policy description for dashboards and audits. Maximum 256 characters.

fields.name: spot_markets
fields.doc: Allowed spot markets for this policy.

fields.name: perp_markets
fields.doc: Allowed perp markets and optional per-contract leverage caps.

fields.name: spot_market_scope
fields.doc: Market-level scope for spot markets. When unspecified, defaults to ALL.

fields.name: perp_market_scope
fields.doc: Market-level scope for perp contracts. When unspecified, defaults to ALL.

fields.name: actions
fields.doc:
High-level actions enabled for the sub-account policy. Up to 64 unique
 explicit actions are allowed.

fields.name: global_notional_cap
fields.doc:
Maximum total notional exposure across all positions for this sub-account,
 expressed in the canonical quote unit (for example, micro-USDT). A value of
 0 means no explicit cap.

fields.name: max_order_notional
fields.doc:
Maximum notional size for any single order on this sub-account, expressed
 in the canonical quote unit (for example, micro-USDT). A value of 0 means
 no explicit cap.

fields.name: max_open_orders
fields.doc:
Maximum number of resting orders allowed on this sub-account at any time.
 A value of 0 means no explicit cap.

fields.name: max_open_positions
fields.doc:
Maximum number of open perp positions allowed on this sub-account. A value
 of 0 means no explicit cap.

fields.name: global_perp_leverage_x
fields.doc:
Optional global leverage cap across all perp contracts. Supported non-zero
 values are 1, 3, 5, 10, 20, 50, and 100. A value of 0 means no explicit cap.

fields.name: daily_internal_transfer_out_limit
fields.doc:
Maximum total notional this sub-account can transfer out internally per
 rolling day, expressed in the canonical quote unit (for example,
 micro-USDT). A value of 0 means no explicit cap.

fields.name: daily_withdraw_limit
fields.doc:
Maximum total notional this sub-account can withdraw per rolling day,
 expressed in the canonical quote unit (for example, micro-USDT). A value of
 0 means no explicit cap.

fields.name: internal_transfers_own_only
fields.doc:
When true, internal transfers from this sub-account may only target other
 sub-accounts owned by the same root account.

fields.name: enforce_withdraw_whitelist
fields.doc:
When true, external withdrawals from this sub-account must target an
 approved withdrawal destination.

fields.name: trading_halted
fields.doc:
When true, new orders for this sub-account are rejected regardless of other
 policy settings.

fields.name: liquidation_only
fields.doc: When true, this sub-account may only reduce or close existing exposure.

fields.name: daily_loss_limit
fields.doc:
Maximum realized loss over a rolling day before safety controls may halt
 activity, expressed in the canonical quote unit (for example, micro-USDT).
 A value of 0 means no explicit limit.

fields.name: intraday_drawdown_limit_bps
fields.doc:
Maximum drawdown from peak equity in basis points. One basis point is
 1/100 of one percent. A value of 0 means no explicit limit.

fields.name: locked
fields.doc: When true, the policy is write-protected and requires an elevated mutation path.

fields.name: review_at
fields.doc: Optional review time in UTC. This does not automatically disable the policy.

fields.name: expires_at
fields.doc: Optional expiry time in UTC. This does not automatically disable the policy.

types.name: auth.v1.UpdateSubaccountRequest
types.doc: Request to update mutable display and status fields for a sub-account.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc: Sub-account to update (opaque ID).

fields.name: label
fields.doc: New label for the sub-account. If empty, the label is left unchanged.

cel.message: label must not contain '<' or '>'

fields.name: icon
fields.doc: New user-chosen icon/emoji for UI display. If empty, left unchanged.

fields.name: color
fields.doc: New user-chosen color token for UI display. If empty, left unchanged. Tokens use lowercase letters, numbers, underscores, or hyphens.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: New status for the sub-account, such as "active" or "disabled". If empty, the status is left unchanged.

types.name: auth.v1.UpdateSubaccountResponse
types.doc: Empty response returned after updating a sub-account.

types.name: auth.v1.UserProfile
types.doc: UserProfile is the caller's public profile and account metadata.

fields.name: username
fields.doc:
Public username for the root account. Usernames are unique
 case-insensitively and use 3 to 32 letters, digits, underscores, dots, or
 hyphens. Empty means no username is set.

fields.name: bio
fields.doc: Short public bio. Maximum length is 256 characters.

fields.name: website
fields.doc: Public website URL, if set. Maximum length is 256 characters.

fields.name: twitter
fields.doc: X/Twitter handle without "@". Maximum length is 15 characters.

fields.name: twitter_verified
fields.doc: Whether the X/Twitter handle for this account has been verified.

fields.name: discord
fields.doc: Discord handle or username without "@". Maximum length is 64 characters.

fields.name: discord_verified
fields.doc: Whether the Discord handle for this account has been verified.

fields.name: avatar_url
fields.doc: Avatar URL, if set. Maximum length is 256 characters.

fields.name: created_at
fields.doc:
Account creation time in UTC. This is the canonical "member since"
 timestamp.

fields.name: next_username_change_at
fields.doc:
Next time in UTC when the username can be changed again. Omitted when no
 cooldown applies.

fields.name: vip_tier
fields.doc:
Current VIP tier for this root account. A value of 0 is the base tier.
 Read-only.

fields.name: username_unlocked
fields.doc: Whether this account is currently allowed to claim/change a username.

types.name: auth.v1.UserProfilePatch
types.doc:
UserProfilePatch is a partial profile update. Fields are
 optional/presence-aware:
 - if a field is omitted, it is not modified
 - if a field is present with an empty string, it is cleared
 Username changes are subject to account eligibility, reserved-name checks,
 uniqueness, and cooldown rules. Case-only username changes update display
 casing without consuming the cooldown.

fields.name: username
fields.doc:
Public username for the root account. Use an empty string to clear it.
 Non-empty values must be 3 to 32 letters, digits, underscores, dots, or
 hyphens.

cel.message: username must be empty or 3-32 chars of letters, digits, underscore, dot, hyphen

fields.name: bio
fields.doc:
Short public bio. Use an empty string to clear it. Non-empty values must be
 at most 256 characters and cannot contain "<" or ">".

cel.message: bio must be empty or <= 256 characters and must not contain '<' or '>'

fields.name: website
fields.doc:
Public website URL. Use an empty string to clear it. Non-empty values must
 be valid http(s) URLs up to 256 characters.

cel.message: website must be empty or a valid http(s) URL

fields.name: twitter
fields.doc:
X/Twitter handle without "@". Use an empty string to clear it. Non-empty
 values must be 1 to 15 letters, digits, or underscores.

cel.message: twitter must be empty or a valid handle (letters, digits, underscore; without '@')

fields.name: avatar_url
fields.doc:
Avatar URL. Use an empty string to clear it. Non-empty values must be valid
 http(s) URLs up to 256 characters.

cel.message: avatar_url must be empty or a valid http(s) URL
